name: schedule_release
description: Schedules a release. If replicas is omitted the service uses 2; replicas must be from 1 to 10. start_at and timezone must be supplied together. The rollout strategy defaults to all-at-once. For canary rollouts, canary_percentage defaults to 10 and must be from 1 to 100. A production release requires approval_ticket. The scheduler validates this and returns an id.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone paired with start_at.

rollout_strategy.description: How traffic moves to the new release.

canary_percentage.description: Traffic percentage for a canary release.
